layouts.name: Solo (TP only)
layouts.satz: All cards work as one tensor-parallel group that prefills and decodes; no switching, no front.
why: 5 cards: the planner is checked for 2 to 4 cards (a launcher dry run per card count); more cards are not calculated here yet (not supported yet).

layouts.name: Flip
layouts.satz: The same cards work alternately as prefill group P (pipeline) and decode group D (tensor-parallel); the weights are exchanged through the host.
why: 5 cards: the planner is checked for 2 to 4 cards (a launcher dry run per card count); more cards are not calculated here yet (not supported yet).

layouts.name: Dual
layouts.satz: P and D are awake at the same time on the same cards; no switching, but both layouts hold weights at once.
why: 5 cards: the planner is checked for 2 to 4 cards (a launcher dry run per card count); more cards are not calculated here yet (not supported yet).
Dual is calibrated on the NVFP4 weights only (the launcher's dual form has no INT8 reference profile).

note: A rough necessary condition from the model fact sheet and the card data. The planner's computation (next step) decides; a layout shown as possible can still be refused there, a blocked one cannot be forced here.
